summary: Explains `--diff`, usable alone or with `--check`, which shows changes made or that would be made by modules supporting diff (common for file modules like template, also others like user). Because output is large, it's best used on a single host with `--limit`.
questions: How do I see what lines a template task would change?
How do I keep diff output manageable?

answer_card.title: Use diff mode
answer_card.answer_md:
`--diff` can be used alone (shows changes made) or with `--check` (shows changes that would be made). It's most common in file modules like `template`, but others like `user` can show before/after info too.

Diff output is large, so check one host at a time:
```console
ansible-playbook foo.yml --check --diff --limit foo.example.com
```
